input.summary: Complete T-A-G left to right and T-E-A-M in order, lock one ball in each saucer, then shoot Release for three-ball Multiball and 3x playfield scoring. Use the left return lane to light the right spinner, then continue through the upper-left lock saucer and top lanes.

quickInfo.name: Locks
quickInfo.summary: Completing T-A-G left to right lights the upper-left lock saucer. Completing T-E-A-M in order lights the lower-right lock saucer.

quickInfo.name: Three-ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: After both balls are locked, Release starts three-ball play with 3x playfield scoring.

quickInfo.name: Lit right spinner
quickInfo.summary: The left return lane lights the right spinner briefly for 10,000 per spin, or 30,000 during Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Bonus Collect
quickInfo.summary: Build base bonus to 20,000 to light one of the two lock saucers or Release. Slingshot hits move the lit collect; the shot scores base bonus with Bonus X and preserves the multiplier.

quickInfo.name: Last Chance
quickInfo.summary: While a lock saucer holds a ball, draining through the lit left outlane releases that ball and continues play.

quickInfo.name: Reverse top lanes
quickInfo.summary: Roll through each lit top lane to turn it off. Clearing all three raises Bonus X; at 5x, the lit top lane awards Special.

steps.text: Complete the T-A-G drop targets from left to right, then shoot the lit upper-left lock saucer.
modeNotes: Build the T-A-G lock first. While a ball is held there, the lit left outlane releases that ball and continues play as Last Chance.

steps.text: Complete the lower-right T-E-A-M drop targets in order, then shoot the lit lower-right lock saucer.
After both balls are locked, shoot the left Release horseshoe to start three-ball Multiball and 3x playfield scoring.
During Multiball, roll through the left return lane to light the right spinner, then shoot the lit spinner for 30,000 per spin.

During Multiball, shoot the upper-left lock saucer from the right flipper. After its kickout, shoot the gate to the top lanes and roll through each lit lane. Clearing all three raises Bonus X; at 5x, the lit top lane awards Special.

alternatives.title: Novelty-settings Extra Ball and Special
alternatives.when: Use these routes only when the tournament setting converts Extra Ball and Special to 500,000 points.

steps.text: Roll through the right return lane to light the lane left of the T in T-A-G, then repeat that lane while it is lit to work toward Extra Ball.
After Bonus X reaches 5x, shoot the lit top lane for Special. Reach it through the spinner, the upper gate right of G, or the gap left of T-A-G.

cautions.issue: T-A-G rebounds can drain through the center.
cautions.response: Watch each rebound before taking the next target.

checkBeforePlay: Test both lock saucers, Release, the left-return-lane spinner lamp, the right spinner, and the upper gate.

noteDetails.label: Top-player proof
items: At Arcade Expo 2019, Karl DeAngelo and the other finalists built the T-A-G lock before T-E-A-M, then used three-ball play for the lit right spinner at 30,000 per spin.
At the Arcade Expo semifinal, Karl DeAngelo, Mark Gilmore, David Oliver, and Gene Lewin held a lock for left-outlane protection and repeatedly shot the lit spinner.
Extra Ball and Special were each worth 500,000 on that event's novelty settings.

steps.title: Lock both balls
steps.text: Complete T-A-G from left to right and shoot the lit upper-left lock saucer. Complete T-E-A-M in order and shoot the lit lower-right lock saucer.
